text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Did you see that, sir?!
You witnessed my victory!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"This is entirely thanks to
your guidance, Boss!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Because you guided me all the way here
when I was agonizing over my inability to carry out my own justice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've taken another step closer
to the hero of justice I'm striving to be, sir!
choice_data_list: I know you can do it — you can become a hero of justice!
I know you can become one—a champion of justice!
Let's train even harder. For justice!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I've taken another step closer
to the hero of justice I'm striving to be, sir!
choice_data_list: I know you can do it — you can become a hero of justice!
I know you can become one—a champion of justice!
Let's train even harder. For justice!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I shall continue to charge down the path of justice alongside the Boss, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Until the day I can become the hero of justice I strive to be!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Of course, sir!
I am still far too inexperienced to call myself an ally of justice, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I intend to continue striving forward
so that my continued victories may serve as a fine example!
